comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic media from finished washers; PR lays two robot-axis cables into a cable carrier and snaps all crossbars shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests free-body granular passage and bridge clearing; PR tests deformable cable routing, ordering, strain-relief protection, and repeated snap-latching.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no spill/damage, and released screen dwell; PR requires both cables correctly ordered inside all 12 links, every bar latched, adequate end extension, no strain-relief slip, release, and 1 s rest.
comparison.reason: Granular screening is not deformable cable routing and multi-latch closure; shared bimanual coordination is only a generic primitive, and both rubrics are complete enough.
